## `neuro.string.isWellFormed`

Instance method on `String.prototype`.

> Returns true if all leading surrogates and trailing surrogates appear paired and in order.

## Signatures

```ts
isWellFormed(input: { string: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<boolean>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `String.prototype.isWellFormed` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
